metric.diagnostics.method: Reviewed Java compiler/runtime diagnostic behavior as exercised by adversarial programs (compile-error variants _C, runtime-error variants _R) under javac/java.
observations: javac produces precise compile-time diagnostics with file/line/column; since JDK 14+ helpful NullPointerException messages give improved runtime diagnostics.

Runtime exceptions provide full stack traces with class/method/line info by default, aiding debuggability across ADV-*_R cases (StackOverflowError for deep recursion, ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, ClassCastException, etc. carry descriptive messages).
Checked exceptions force call-site acknowledgment of failure modes at compile time, a diagnostics-relevant design property, though it can add boilerplate.

Weaknesses: type erasure means some generic-related mistakes surface only as runtime ClassCastException rather than compile-time errors; unchecked exception misuse paths are not enforced by the compiler.
metric.diagnostics.score_rationale: Score 83/100: mature, detailed compiler diagnostics and stack traces, improved further by helpful NPE messages and checked-exception enforcement; deductions for generics type-erasure diagnostic gaps and boilerplate-heavy exception model.

metric.functionality_expressiveness.method: Qualitative review of Java language feature set against template micro/adversarial programs (java/micro mb00-mb11, java/adversarial ADV-01..ADV-26) covering numeric overflow, mutation-during-iteration, recursion depth, generics, collections.
observations: Java offers a mature generics system (type erasure limits reification), a large standard collections/streams API, lambdas, records, sealed classes, and pattern matching (switch expressions, instanceof patterns) in recent LTS releases.

Expressiveness reduced by verbosity: checked exceptions require explicit throws/catch boilerplate, no native tuples, no algebraic data type sugar beyond sealed interfaces plus records, no first-class union types.
Concurrency primitives (java.util.concurrent, virtual threads) are expressive but require explicit API usage rather than language-level async syntax.

ADV-15 shows ArrayList mutation during for-each iteration behaves per iterator contract; ADV-01_C shows narrowing long-to-int casts silently truncate per spec, requiring explicit casts rather than range-checked conversions.
metric.functionality_expressiveness.score_rationale: Score 78/100: strong general-purpose expressiveness (generics, streams, modern pattern matching, records) offset by verbosity, type erasure limitations, and lack of algebraic/value-type sugar found in newer languages.
